message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise‑related complaints directly with the city.  
Here’s how:

| How to File | Contact |
|-------------|---------|
| **Online** – Use the City of Atlanta’s “Noise Complaint” form on the official website. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **Phone (non‑emergency)** – Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **Phone (emergency)** – If the noise is causing immediate danger, dial 911. | 911 |
| **In‑person** – Visit the Atlanta Police Department’s 311 Service Center at 1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303. | 1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

When filing, be ready to provide:
* Your name and contact information (optional but helpful)
* The address or location of the disturbance
* Time and duration of the noise
* A brief description of the source (e.g., construction, loud music, barking dogs)

The city’s noise ordinance allows the police to investigate and issue citations if the complaint is substantiated. If you’re dealing with a recurring issue, you may also want to keep a log of dates, times, and descriptions to support your case.
